metadata.description: zOne Playground: AI tools for zOne workflows that make your code more powerful. A growing set of Claude Code plugins that take the busywork out of the day: testing, doc preparation, debugging, code refactoring and more. Describe what you need, and let the tools read the code, do the work and show you the evidence.

plugins.name: zone-test
plugins.description: End-to-end testing for the zOne app with Playwright: study a feature's code, design test cases, write the Playwright suite, run it, fix test defects, and produce a PDF report.

plugins.name: zoffice
plugins.description: Turn today's Claude Code sessions into zOffice time sheet entries, then post them to the Daily Activities page with Playwright.

plugins.name: zwork
plugins.description: Azure DevOps work, faster: list your bugs, tasks and PRs by state, review PRs and work items against the code, and plan and fix bugs and tasks by ID.
